group.div: Conditional routing fields appear when Action is Conditional Logic.
Wait and variable fields appear when Action is Wait for Response or Set Variable.
Assignment and CRM fields appear when Action is Transfer to Agent, Assign Tag, or Create Lead.
Use Message Text in Action Configuration for the optional CRM lead note.

field.name: cta_button_url
field.placeholder: Leave empty to use account Shop / Catalogue URL

group.div: WhatsApp CTA URL messages support one URL button. They are session messages, so use an approved template when the 24-hour window is closed.

field.name: catalog_id
field.placeholder: Leave empty to use account Meta Catalog ID

group.div: Use Full Catalog to open the WhatsApp shop, Single Product for one item, and Multi-Product List for up to 30 product IDs.

field.name: form_id
field.placeholder: Leave empty to use account default form

group.div: Form links are tokenized public links. Submissions stay in WhatsApp Form Submissions until a user reviews and creates/updates CRM data.
Payment links use the WhatsApp Account payment mode. Enable Manual URL or Odoo Invoice / Quote Link on the account first.
URL, catalog, form, and payment fields appear when the matching commerce action is selected.
HTTP and delay fields appear when Action is HTTP Request or Add Delay.

page.name: buttons
page.div: Option rows appear when Action is Send Buttons/Quick Replies or Send List Menu.

Add one row per customer option. Quick Reply supports up to 3 buttons; List Menu supports up to 10 rows. Button Text is what the customer sees. Button ID is the payload/keyword saved from WhatsApp. Go To Step controls where the flow continues.

field.name: catalog_id
field.placeholder: Leave empty to use account default

group.div: URL and Product actions send one special WhatsApp interactive message and then continue to Go To Step. They do not wait for a reply payload.

sheet.div: Button Text is shown to the customer. Reply buttons use Button ID as the internal WhatsApp payload. URL/Product actions are for single-action buttons, while normal Quick Reply supports up to 3 reply buttons.

field.name: catalog_id
field.placeholder: Leave empty to use account default

sheet.div: Reply buttons wait for a tap and send Button ID back to the flow. URL/Product actions send one special interactive message and then continue; use templates for CTA phone buttons or closed-session outreach.
Use AI Draft Flow for inactive editable suggestions only. Review routes, account defaults, forms, payment mode, templates, and catalog IDs before activation.
